opportunities.name: Renewal missing-health duelist
opportunities.objective: Use two Mantra-W heal timings rather than a single poke cycle.
opportunities.mechanic: Renewal heals an AP-linked percentage of missing health at both tether start and completion; normal W must stay linked for two seconds to root. Visage amplifies healing received, Rod supports mana/health, and Cosmic Drive plus Inspire speed helps preserve tether. Ability damage reduces Mantra cooldown by four seconds, enabling a pressure-dependent next renewal.
opportunities.requiredState: Need missing health without lethal risk, unbroken tether and actual champion ability hits.
opportunities.failure: Anti-heal, burst before the first heal or a broken tether removes the second payoff.
opportunities.test: Compare both heal events, Mantra cooldown and survival versus a mobile melee target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mantra's heal is not flat max-health healing and a broken tether does not grant the completion heal.

opportunities.name: Inspire AP transfer engine
opportunities.objective: Let offensive hits finance repeated multi-ally shield windows.
opportunities.mechanic: Inspire's base shield has 0.6 AP; Mantra adds 0.45 AP shielding and spreads protection to allies. Staff supplies temporary AP/haste after an allied shield, Moonstone can chain shields, and Helia spends damage-earned charges when shielding. Gathering Fire makes well-timed Q/W champion hits valuable before the next defensive Mantra, rather than substituting auto attacks for documented refunds.
opportunities.requiredState: Need grouped allies for empowered E and safe actual spell damage between shield casts.
opportunities.failure: Mana pressure or threat forces pure shielding, slowing Mantra refunds and Helia charge gains.
opportunities.test: Measure primary and nearby shields plus Mantra uptime in a repeated poke-and-protect sequence.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Every allied shield is not an independent infinite Helia charge source; charges must be earned first.

ruledOut.reason: Gathering Fire's current tooltip specifies champion ability damage, not ordinary attacks.

unknowns: Karma Q conditional wrapper is unresolved; identify current normal-Q expression before quoting a numerical burst total.

builds.name: Renewal missing-health duelist
builds.summary: Use two Mantra-W heal timings rather than a single poke cycle.
builds.goal: Use two Mantra-W heal timings rather than a single poke cycle.
builds.hypothesis: Renewal heals an AP-linked percentage of missing health at both tether start and completion; normal W must stay linked for two seconds to root. Visage amplifies healing received, Rod supports mana/health, and Cosmic Drive plus Inspire speed helps preserve tether. Ability damage reduces Mantra cooldown by four seconds, enabling a pressure-dependent next renewal.
testPlan: Required state: Need missing health without lethal risk, unbroken tether and actual champion ability hits.
Compare both heal events, Mantra cooldown and survival versus a mobile melee target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Anti-heal, burst before the first heal or a broken tether removes the second payoff.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Mantra's heal is not flat max-health healing and a broken tether does not grant the completion heal.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rod of Ages, Spirit Visage, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
